name: phospholipase C beta 3

function.text: PLCB3 is the approved symbol for phospholipase C beta 3. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in C-type glycerophospholipase activity; cadherin binding; G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Lung adenocarcinoma; Prostate adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: PLCB3 encodes phospholipase C beta 3. Its functions include C-type glycerophospholipase activity and cadherin binding.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PLCB3 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma and prostate adenocarcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
